title: AlifGunadi Office event (envelope v1)
description: Body of POST /event on the AlifGunadi Office server. Send it with the header X-AlifGunadi-Office: 1 to 127.0.0.1:<port>. The server keeps only the properties listed here and silently ignores everything else, so extra fields are harmless but never stored. v and source are optional: a sender that omits them is treated as claude-code, schema v1. Changes to this schema are additive only.

source.description: Which agent product sent the event (claude-code, antigravity, opencode, ...). Together with session_id it identifies a session, so equal session ids from different products never collide.

hook_event_name.description: Claude Code hook event name. Handled: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TeammateIdle, Stop, StopFailure, SessionEnd. Other names are accepted and ignored.

agent_type.description: Desk id of the subagent (nested ids such as engineering/lead-dba are reduced to lead-dba).

notification_type.description: Handled: permission_prompt, idle_prompt, agent_needs_input, elicitation_dialog, elicitation_url_dialog.

tool_input.description: Only these four properties are kept. Senders must already minimise them: base name instead of path, program name instead of command line.

command.description: The server keeps only the first word.
